description: Single-molecule fluorescence acquisition: stream photons from real TCSPC hardware or the built-in tttrlib Sim* photon simulator (confocal diffusion with FRET, anisotropy and photophysics).

rpc_methods.name: acq.simulation.run
rpc_methods.summary: Simulate a single-molecule confocal photon stream
rpc_methods.description: Run the tttrlib Sim* photon simulator: Brownian diffusion of fluorophores through a confocal excitation focus, with N-state photophysics/FRET, rotational anisotropy and CW/pulsed emission, returning (or writing) the photon stream (macro-time window, routing channel, micro-time/TAC channel). Every parameter maps onto tttrlib's SimSystem / SimSpecies / SimGrid / SimIntegrator; this per-parameter help is the single source of truth shared by the GUI tooltips, the CLI, the Python API and this RPC method. Diffusion/rate/brightness units share one abstract MACRO-time unit (ChiSurf/BurstNet convention: milliseconds, so a rate of 1.0 = 1 kHz); the micro-time / TAC axis is a separate axis in nanoseconds.

N_species.title: Species
N_species.description: Number of molecular / photophysical states (default 1). Brightness q, diffusion D and the N×N rate matrices are all sized by this. Use ≥2 for FRET states, species mixtures, or blinking (a bright + a dark state).

N_channels.title: Detection channels
N_channels.description: Number of detection (routing) channels (default 2). 2 = donor/acceptor; 4 = 2-colour PIE or polarization-resolved; 6 = 3-colour, or colour×polarization.

M.title: Population (per species)
M.description: Open-volume expected molecule count per species IN THE BOX (default [1.5]); with the box size this sets the concentration (= M / box volume). smFRET is dilute — on average ~1 molecule in the focus (single-digit to tens of pM).

D.title: Diffusion coefficient (per species)
D.description: Translational diffusion coefficient per species, µm² per macro-time unit (ms ⇒ µm²/ms). Typical: free dyes ~0.3–0.5, labelled proteins ~0.05–0.15; default 3.0 is a fast 'toy' value. 0 = immobile.

q.title: Brightness q (species×channel)
q.description: Peak molecular brightness per (species, channel): photons per macro-time unit at the focus centre (ms ⇒ kHz). Flattened species-major: [q(sp0,ch0), q(sp0,ch1), q(sp1,ch0), …]. Single-molecule peak brightness is typically ~20–100 kHz; the channel split encodes FRET efficiency / anisotropy.

q_bg.title: Background rate (per channel)
q_bg.description: Uncorrelated background (dark counts + scatter) per channel, photons per macro-time unit (ms ⇒ kHz). Typical confocal ~0.5–2 kHz per channel. Default 0.

k_rad.title: Intensity-dependent rates k_rad
k_rad.description: N×N row-major (i→j) transition-rate matrix SCALED by the local excitation intensity — photo-induced processes such as photobleaching — per macro-time unit. Length N_species². All-zero = no light-driven transitions (the common case).

k_nrad.title: Spontaneous rates k_nrad
k_nrad.description: N×N row-major (i→j) SPONTANEOUS transition-rate matrix, per macro-time unit — blinking / conformational dynamics, independent of excitation. e.g. a two-state blinker uses k(bright→dark) and k(dark→bright). Length N_species².

box_xy.title: Box radius XY (µm)
box_xy.description: Lateral half-extent of the ellipsoidal simulation box (µm, default 2). Must exceed the focus by a few diffusion lengths; larger = more dilute but slower. Prefer 'Active margin' (Performance) to auto-shrink around the focus instead of a tiny box.

box_z.title: Box radius Z (µm)
box_z.description: Axial half-extent of the box (µm, default 4), usually ~2× box_xy for a prolate confocal volume.

focus_param.title: Focus waists [w0, z0] (µm)
focus_param.description: Excitation Gaussian 1/e² radii [w0 (lateral), z0 (axial)] in µm (default [0.3, 2.0]). Confocal: w0 ~0.2–0.4, aspect z0/w0 ~3–6. Field I ∝ exp(-2((x²+y²)/w0² + z²/z0²)).

r0.title: Fundamental anisotropy r0
r0.description: Fundamental (time-zero) fluorescence anisotropy (default 0 = anisotropy off). Physical range −0.2…0.4; organic dyes ~0.36–0.4. >0 enables photoselection + rotational depolarization (needs a decay pattern and D_rot).

l1.title: Polarization mixing l1
l1.description: Detection-path polarization mixing for the PARALLEL channel (objective/optics depolarization). Small: ~0–0.05 (typical ~0.03).

l2.title: Polarization mixing l2
l2.description: Detection-path polarization mixing for the PERPENDICULAR channel. Small: ~0–0.05 (typical ~0.04).

D_rot.title: Rotational diffusion D_rot
D_rot.description: Rotational diffusion coefficient, rad²/ns (default 0). Depolarizes emission over the fluorescence lifetime (Perrin). A protein with rotational correlation time of a few ns corresponds to D_rot ~0.05.

dt.title: Time-window dt
dt.description: Diffusion/integration window in the macro-time unit (ms ⇒ 0.001 = 1 µs; default 0.01). Sets the diffusion resolution — do NOT enlarge it for speed (it is sub-stepped internally, so it won't help; use the Performance knobs instead).

N_ph_max.title: Stop after photons
N_ph_max.description: Stop once this many photons are generated (fixed-COUNT mode, default 1e6; a training chunk is often ~1e5). For a fixed measurement DURATION set 'Max windows' > 0 instead (Independent-molecule mode requires that).

max_windows.title: Stop after windows
max_windows.description: Fixed-DURATION stop: measurement duration = max_windows × dt (0 = unlimited, default 0). e.g. 10 min at dt = 1 µs ⇒ 6e8 windows. REQUIRED by Independent-molecule mode, which then ignores N_ph_max.

rmt1seed.title: Diffusion seed
rmt1seed.description: RNG seed for diffusion, geometry and state transitions. Fix it for reproducible traces; change it for independent replicates.

rmt2seed.title: Emission seed
rmt2seed.description: RNG seed for emission, channel choice and background (independent of the diffusion seed).

N_tac_channels.title: Micro-time (TAC) channels
N_tac_channels.description: Number of micro-time (TCSPC/TAC) channels on the fluorescence-decay axis (default 4096; match the instrument, typically 1024–4096). N_tac × tac_dt should span one laser period.

tac_dt.title: TAC resolution (ns)
tac_dt.description: Micro-time channel width in NANOSECONDS (the TAC/TCSPC resolution; default ≈0.004 ns). Separate ns axis from the macro-time.

laser_period.title: Laser period (ns)
laser_period.description: Pulsed-excitation repetition period in NANOSECONDS (default 13.596 ≈ 73.5 MHz). Micro-times wrap modulo this. Only relevant in Pulsed mode.

analytic_excitation.title: Analytic Gaussian focus
analytic_excitation.description: Evaluate the excitation Gaussian analytically instead of sampling a voxel grid: zero construction cost and memory, and exact — but for a GAUSSIAN focus only. Leave OFF to use the general voxel grid, which supports any measured / ISM / aberrated PSF. Turn on only when the focus is a clean 3D Gaussian.

excitation_extent.title: Grid extent [xy, z] (µm)
excitation_extent.description: Optional [xy, z] half-extent of the excitation voxel grid, INDEPENDENT of the box (µm). Sizing it to the focus (e.g. [3, 5]) instead of the full box makes grid construction ~50× cheaper with IDENTICAL physics, since the field is ≈0 outside. Empty = span the whole box. Ignored when 'Analytic Gaussian focus' is on.

psf_type.title: PSF / focus model
psf_type.description: Point-spread / molecule-detection function for the excitation focus. 'gaussian3d' = separable 3D Gaussian (waists [w0, z0]); 'analytic_gaussian3d' = same Gaussian evaluated grid-free (zero build cost, exact, Gaussian only — equivalent to 'Analytic Gaussian focus'); 'gaussian_lorentzian' = confocal MDF with a z-expanding waist w(z)²=w0²(1+(z/zR)²) (uses w0 and the Rayleigh range zR); 'radial' = a numeric/measured radially-symmetric PSF loaded from a file (see 'PSF file').

psf_zR.title: Rayleigh range zR (µm)
psf_zR.description: Rayleigh range zR (µm) for the Gaussian-Lorentzian PSF: the axial distance over which the beam waist expands by √2 (w(z)²=w0²(1+(z/zR)²)). Confocal ~0.5–1.5 µm. Only used when PSF model = 'gaussian_lorentzian'.

psf_file.title: PSF file (radial)
psf_file.description: Path to a numeric/measured radially-symmetric PSF sampled on the (r, z) half-plane: .npy (2D [nz, nr] array), .npz ('rz' + steps), or .mat (PyBroMo). Only used when PSF model = 'radial'. The PSF is filled into the voxel grid by bilinear interpolation at r=√(x²+y²).

psf_r_step.title: PSF r step (µm)
psf_r_step.description: Radial (r) sample spacing of the numeric PSF file, in µm. Only used for PSF model = 'radial' when not supplied by the file itself (.npz).

psf_z_step.title: PSF z step (µm)
psf_z_step.description: Axial (z) sample spacing of the numeric PSF file, in µm. Only used for PSF model = 'radial' when not supplied by the file itself (.npz).

per_molecule_skip.title: Coasting (skip far molecules)
per_molecule_skip.description: Coasting: a molecule far from BOTH the focus and the box surface skips its per-window diffusion/emission and is caught up EXACTLY on wake. Large speedup for dilute samples and statistically exact (±0.1%) — safe to leave on for FCS/smFRET. No effect during a scan.

coast_safety.title: Coast safety factor
coast_safety.description: How conservative coasting is: a sleeper's per-step displacement std ≤ (distance-to-boundary) / coast_safety (default 3; 3–4 typical). Larger = safer but slower. Only used when Coasting is on.

min_coast_windows.title: Min coast windows
min_coast_windows.description: Never sleep a molecule for fewer than this many windows (default 8) — avoids coasting overhead on short gaps. Only used when Coasting is on.

focus_threshold.title: Focus threshold (frac of peak)
focus_threshold.description: Fraction of peak excitation that defines the effective-focus bounding box shared by Coasting, the two-step lookup and the Active margin (default 1e-3). Smaller ⇒ a larger, more conservative focus box.

fast_grid_bbox.title: Two-step field lookup
fast_grid_bbox.description: Reject far-from-focus field queries with a cheap 6-comparison bounding-box test before the trilinear interpolation. Drops the sub-threshold field tail — a small, statistically unbiased approximation. Safe to leave on; biggest help with large voxel grids.

independent_molecules.title: Independent-molecule mode
independent_molecules.description: Simulate each molecule's WHOLE timeline independently (coasting far, fine-stepping near the focus) and merge the streams — embarrassingly parallel across molecules (combine with worker threads). REQUIRES 'Max windows' > 0 (fixed duration) and IGNORES N_ph_max. Big throughput win for dilute samples.

active_margin.title: Active-domain margin (µm)
active_margin.description: Shrink the simulated box to the focus AABB + this margin (µm), holding concentration fixed, so molecules that never reach the focus are never simulated (open-volume only; default 0 = off, ~7× faster at ~2 µm). Exact for diffusion/FCS. WARNING for INTERNAL KINETICS: the margin must exceed √(2·D / k_min) so a molecule reaches its stationary bright/dark distribution BEFORE entering the focus — too small biases brightness (measured up to +6% for a fast ~2–3 kHz blinker at 1.5 µm).

output_path.description: Path to the written SPC / photon-stream file(s), if an output path was given (else null).
